name: wait-dropped-and-cycle
about: The waiting stage (docs/decisions/2026-10-22-waiting-stage.md). d's build agent finds it needs c merged first and returns the wait outcome: the runner reports it, and d waits on #1 instead of asking the user. Parking c on d would make a cycle: refused with the cycle, and c stays in build. Then the user drops c: loopd sends d to the user with the reason, as a dropped dependency does, and the answer sends it back to build, the stage it was waiting to return to.
